title: Helwit Pear Nicotine Pouches 9mg
description: Helwit Pear Nicotine Pouches deliver a smooth, subtly sweet fruit flavour with the gentle taste of ripe Pear. Each pouch contains 9mg of nicotine and is crafted from plant-based fibres for comfort and discretion. Produced in Sweden using climate-compensated methods, Helwit Pear offers a clean, fruity experience in a practical, tobacco-free format. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
